arxiv-2011-10571.title: Efficient computation of baryon interpolating fields in Lattice QCD
arxiv-2011-10571.creator: \firstname Eloy \lastname Romero \fnsep, \firstname Kostas \lastname Orginos \fnsep
arxiv-2011-10571.description: Abstract In this work we present an efficient construction of baryon interpolating fields for lattice QCD computations of two and three point functions. These are essential building blocks of computations of nucleon parton distribution functions (PDFs), generalized parton distribution functions (GPDs) and transverse momentum dependent distributions functions (TMDs).

arxiv-2209-11317.title: Symplectic circuits, entanglement, and stimulated Hawking radiation in analog gravity
arxiv-2209-11317.creator: Anthony J. Brady, Ivan Agullo, Dimitrios Kranas
arxiv-2209-11317.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Anthony J. Brady, Ivan Agullo, Dimitrios Kranas. We introduce a convenient set of analytical tools (the Gaussian formalism) and diagrams (symplectic circuits) to analyze multi-mode scattering events in analog gravity, such as pair-creation a lá Hawking by black hole and white hole analog event horizons. The diagrams prove to be valuable ansatzes for the scattering dynamics, especially in settings where direct analytic results are not straightforward and one must instead rely on numerical simulations.

arxiv-2308-00841.title: Correlated noise enhances coherence and fidelity in coupled qubits
arxiv-2308-00841.creator: Eric R. Bittner, Hao Li, S. A. Shah, Carlos Silva, Andrei Piryatinski
arxiv-2308-00841.description: Abstract It is generally assumed that environmental noise arising from thermal fluctuations is detrimental to preserving coherence and entanglement in a quantum system. In the simplest sense, dephasing and decoherence are tied to energy fluctuations driven by coupling between the system and the normal modes of the bath.

arxiv-2408-03861.title: A tunable photonic band gap resonator for axion dark matter searches
arxiv-2408-03861.creator: Samantha M. Lewis, Dillon T. Goulart, Mirelys Carcana Barbosa, Alexander F. Leder, Aarav M. Sindhwad, Isabella Urdinaran, Karl van Bibber
arxiv-2408-03861.description: Abstract Axions are a well-motivated dark matter candidate particle. Haloscopes aim to detect axions in the galactic halo by measuring the photon signal resulting from axions interacting with a strong magnetic field. Existing haloscopes are primarily targeting axion masses which produce microwave-range photons and rely on microwave resonators to enhance the signal power.

pmc-11449772.title: Assessing the accuracy of CMRtools software for diagnosing liver iron overload in thalassemia patients: influencing factors and optimisation strategies
pmc-11449772.creator: Chaotian Luo, Fei Peng, Fengming Xu, Cheng Tang, Yanyan Zhang, Chaojie Huang, Linlin Liang, Xiaojing Ning, Peng Peng
pmc-11449772.description: BackgroundCMRtools is a software package that can be used to measure T2* values to diagnose liver iron overload, however, its accuracy in terms is affected by multiple factors, including goodness-of-fit (R2 value), the number of echo time (TE) images, and the liver iron concentration (LIC).

pmc-11715978.title: Large‐scale Plasma Proteomic Profiling Identifies a Robust Set of Biomarkers for Detection of Clinical Alzheimer's Disease
pmc-11715978.creator: Gyujin Heo, Muhammad Ali, Jigyasha Timsina, Menghan Liu, Carlos Cruchaga, Yun Ju Sung
pmc-11715978.description: BackgroundWhile several non‐invasive plasma biomarkers are rapidly developing, they still have lower accuracy than the established CSF biomarkers. This study therefore comprehensively examined 6,905 plasma proteins in over 3,000 individuals to identify novel biomarkers for predicting clinical Alzheimer’s disease (AD) and monitoring disease progression.

pmc-12533100.description: Considering their biodegradability in physiological environments and similar elastic modulus to natural bone, magnesium alloys have generated a lot of interest as biodegradable implant materials. pmc-13203073.description: Plain Language Summary What is this summary about? uslaw-usc-t37-s402a.title: 37 U.S.C. § 402a — Supplemental subsistence allowance for low-income members with dependents
uslaw-usc-t37-s402a.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t37-s402a.description: United States Code, Title 37 (Pay And Allowances Of The Uniformed Services); Chapter 7 (Allowances Other Than Travel And Transportation Allowances). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Supplemental Allowance Required.— (1) The Secretary concerned shall increase the basic allowance for subsistence to which a member of the armed forces described in subsection (b) is otherwise entitled under section 402 of this title.
